title: Shoulder impingement, beginner, bands
message: I'm 52 and new to strength training. My left shoulder gets pinched when I lift my arm overhead; my doctor said it's impingement and that exercise is fine below shoulder height. I want better posture and to feel stronger. 3 days a week, 40 minutes. I have resistance bands and a doorway pull-up bar.

checks.why: arms at or above shoulder height pinch an impinged shoulder
a beginner recovers poorly from high volume
